summary: Tested 6 bug fixes for MoneySutra iteration 143 - All fixes VERIFIED as working

fix_1_back_button_replace.description: BackButton uses navigate(fallbackPath, { replace: true }) when forceNavigate is true
fix_1_back_button_replace.verification: Code review: Line 9 shows navigate(fallbackPath, { replace: true }) within forceNavigate condition

fix_2_wealth_promise_allsettled.description: Wealth page uses Promise.allSettled to prevent failures from blocking
fix_2_wealth_promise_allsettled.verification: Code review: Line 51 uses Promise.allSettled. UI shows 'Expenses: 2 this month ₹38 K' (not 0)

fix_3_loans_optional_fields.description: Loan model has outstandingAmount and startDate as Optional fields
fix_3_loans_optional_fields.verification: Code review: Lines 320, 325 show Optional[float] and Optional[str]. GET /api/loans returns 200

fix_4_investment_allocation_breakdown.description: Financial Health API returns 'breakdown' object in investmentAllocation
fix_4_investment_allocation_breakdown.verification: API returns breakdown with equity/debt/gold/other. UI shows 'Portfolio Breakdown' with Equity: 48.5% ₹1.15L, Debt: 21.3% ₹50.4K, Gold: 30.1% ₹71.1K

fix_5_debt_action_amounts.description: Debt to Asset action text includes actual amounts (rupees and percentage)
fix_5_debt_action_amounts.verification: Action shows: 'Your debt (₹7,154) is just 2.1% of your net worth (₹347,258). Very healthy...'

fix_6_rolling_buttons_no_worth.description: Rolling buttons should NOT have 'Worth' option
fix_6_rolling_buttons_no_worth.verification: Code review: BUTTON_GROUPS has track/grow/plan - no 'Worth'. UI test confirms 'Worth' not in rolling section

fix_7_badges_30_count.verification: ACHIEVEMENTS dict has 30 entries. API returns totalAchievements: 30. UI shows 'Badges 21/30'
